attacker.checkpoint_selection: validation conditional flip fraction over ALL originally detected eligible fraud; identity counts as zero; tie lower cost then earlier checkpoint
attacker.evaluation_action: stochastic squashed Gaussian, fixed source-level evaluation seeds

bandit.action: one squashed continuous proposal then forced STOP; same terminal query contract

court.selection: validation mature Court utility per transaction; tie earlier checkpoint

continual.calibration: latest 25 percent by completion time; no overlap with verified fit subset
continual.insufficient_calibration: retain current model and log ineligible

final.holdout_gate: all phase scientific checks passed and protocol frozen
